grammar.numbers: a signpost pops up beside the map pin: big number (counts up, years and dates as said) over a tiny route chart filled to the value; a number said while the stage is taken rides as a small flag chip left of the pin
grammar.comparisons: a fork in the road: two branches from the pin, a signboard at each end, a VS stone at the junction, the question on a ribbon banner
grammar.steps: a route plan: numbered milestones on a winding trail climbing from the pin, each lighting up as it is said while the pin hops onto it
grammar.eligibility: classic verdict cue ✓/✗ (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up)
grammar.change: classic change cue (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up)
grammar.trend: classic line graph panel (MotionTrack, mounted only while the cue is up)
grammar.lenders: roadside sign right of the pin: logo on white, neutral label
grammar.captionPosition: fixed white map ribbon under the pin, English line in a dashed plate at the bottom

skinAxes.cover: the map with the pin at the road's start, logo tile on white, title in an old map's title cartouche, compass rose
skinAxes.captions: navy words on a white ribbon with notched ends and a gold top edge; keywords blue with a gold underline
skinAxes.framing: pure motion graphics: no footage, no presenter; a gold pin travels an S-curved road at the talk's pace and the camera follows it
skinAxes.transitions: the map keeps sliding under the pin (tilt towards the road's heading, slow zoom); flags planted at every beat; standard chapter transitions
skinAxes.texture: illustrated top-down map: pale sand land, brand-blue river, mint trees, contour rings, tiny houses, faint graticule, warm printed-map edges
skinAxes.sound: voice + cue clicks, stat ding, chapter whoosh
skinAxes.cta: classic white contact card + compliance card
